completion:
Calculate the total number of buildings that have been checked.
3. Extract the number of buildings that failed at least one of the safety checks.
4. If the total number of buildings checked has changed, update your denominator accordingly.
5. Separate out buildings with different risk profiles (address, seating, etc.).
6. Double-check your data entry.

## How do we know these?

1. Look in local/national media
2. Contact fire safety authorities
3. Review government files
4. Check industry reports
